title: Keychron K8 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard (with code PCGAMING)

comparisons.notes: Keychron K8 tenkeyless wireless, 9.99 on Keychron's site. The white backlight red-switch variant is sold out there; the brown-switch version of the same K8 is in stock at the same price.
Keychron K8 TKL, white backlight, red switch, new, 10 in stock (MPN K8).

amazon_match_notes: ASIN from the Woot offer, exact match verified by the price checker.
writeup: Woot has the Keychron K8 tenkeyless wireless mechanical keyboard new for $39.99, and code PCGAMING from Woot's Razer and Keychron gaming event takes another 20% off, bringing it to $31.99. Keychron's own site charges $59.99 for the K8, and OneClick Warehouse lists the white backlight red-switch version at $105.99. The code is limited to one use per customer and runs through November 11.
